entries.en: What happened to Juliet, V... Fuuuuuuck. She never mentioned she had a sister. It's a cryin' shame…
entries.ro: Ce s-a întâmplat cu Juliet, V... Futu-i! Nu a pomenit niciodată că are o soră. Ce păcat de tot…

entries.en: Thanks for grabbin' that data, V. Gig's closed. I'll, uh... I'll be in touch.
entries.ro: Mersi că ai luat datele alea, V. Gig-ul s-a închis. Te sun eu.
